jobs.title: Commercial skippers, Sydney Harbour
jobs.summary: We are building a bench of commercial skippers we can call on in Sydney, from early November 2026. Work is mostly four-hour event and private charter blocks on a commercial passenger vessel, plus the occasional vessel move. Casual, as needed, with more work expected over summer as further commercial vessels come on.
needs: Current commercial skipper qualification for passenger vessels on Sydney Harbour
Able to take short-notice work, ideally with 24-hour turnaround
Happy to be a preferred skipper or a back-up who learns the boat
Professional, presentable and good with guests

jobs.title: Deckhands, Sydney Harbour
jobs.summary: We also need reliable deckhands in Sydney to crew alongside our skippers, from early November 2026. The commercial passenger vessel runs with a minimum crew of two, so every skipper job needs a deckhand. Work is mostly four-hour event and private charter blocks, casual and as needed, with more expected over summer.
needs: Deck experience on charter, commercial or passenger vessels preferred; keen newcomers with the right attitude considered
Current first aid and relevant sea safety certificates
Able to take short-notice work, ideally with 24-hour turnaround
Professional, presentable and good with guests

jobs.title: Stewards, Sydney Harbour
jobs.summary: We are also looking for stewards in Sydney to look after guests on event and private charter blocks aboard the commercial passenger vessel, working alongside the skipper and deckhand. Casual and as needed, with more work expected over summer.
needs: Hospitality or yacht interior experience, with a polished and friendly manner
Current RSA and first aid (or willing to obtain)
Able to take short-notice work, ideally with 24-hour turnaround
Presentable, reliable and calm under pressure

jobs.title: Stewards, Gold Coast
jobs.summary: We need stewards on the Gold Coast for owner trips, guest days and charters aboard the motor yachts we look after: guest service, interior care, provisioning and keeping the boat guest-ready. You would work on the motor yachts we look after on the Gold Coast, typically 40 to 120 ft, mostly berthed in Coomera and the surrounding marinas.
needs: Yacht interior or hospitality experience preferred; keen newcomers considered
Current first aid; RSA an advantage
Flexible and available at short notice
Presentable, discreet and detail-minded

jobs.title: Delivery Skippers, Gold Coast
jobs.summary: We run crewed deliveries for owners and need skippers we can call on: east coast passages such as Gold Coast to Sydney and the Whitsundays, and occasionally further afield in the Pacific. Passages run with a crew of three, and you would lead the passage plan and the crew. Vessels are typically 40 to 120 ft motor yachts.
needs: Current commercial skipper qualification suitable for the vessel and passage
Offshore and multi-day passage experience on motor yachts
Comfortable with passage planning, weather routing and running a small crew
Available at short notice for several days at a time

jobs.title: Shore-based Deckhands, Gold Coast
jobs.summary: Shore-based deckhands keep our managed yachts in top condition at the berth: washdowns, deck and exterior care, lines and fenders, maintenance tasks from the worklist, yard-period support and helping move vessels around the marina. You would work on the motor yachts we look after on the Gold Coast, typically 40 to 120 ft, mostly berthed in Coomera and the surrounding marinas.
needs: Deck or marine trade experience preferred; keen newcomers with the right attitude considered
Own transport to Coomera and surrounding marinas
Reliable, hardworking and happy to follow a worklist
Current first aid or willing to obtain

jobs.title: Detailers, Gold Coast
jobs.summary: We are looking for marine detailers to join the team caring for our managed yachts: washdowns, gelcoat and polish, stainless and teak care, canvas and clears, and coating work as booked. You would use our washdown routine and record your work and photos on each job. You would work on the motor yachts we look after on the Gold Coast, typically 40 to 120 ft, mostly berthed in Coomera and the surrounding marinas.
needs: Marine or automotive detailing experience; polishing and coating experience a plus
Attention to detail and pride in finish
Own transport and basic tools
Comfortable working on large vessels, at the berth and during yard periods

jobs.title: Shore-based Skippers, Gold Coast
jobs.summary: Shore-based skippers look after our managed yachts when they are not on a long passage: moving vessels between berths, shipyards and the hardstand, sea trials and engine runs, and relief cover when an owner's captain is away. You would work on the motor yachts we look after on the Gold Coast, typically 40 to 120 ft, mostly berthed in Coomera and the surrounding marinas.
needs: Current skipper qualification suitable for motor yachts to 120 ft
Confident handling large vessels in marinas and rivers around Coomera and the Broadwater
Comfortable with sea trials and basic engine and systems checks
Professional, reliable and good with owners and yard staff
